observed_failure: authoritative CS016E supersession did not resolve EV-00 preflight
root_cause: The CS000F canonical wrapper self-test inherited the live EV-00 lifecycle and asserted that synthetic preflight must be authorized. CS017 R8 had legitimately moved its branch-local EV-00 state to in_progress, so the self-test rejected on the preflight lifecycle rule even though CS016E supersession resolution itself remained correct.
corrective_disposition: Prospective CS000H changes only the canonical authorizer self-test to use explicit lifecycle fixtures; runtime authorization semantics and the preserved R8 failure remain unchanged.
